verdict.rationale: Vanta's own materials say it automatically gathers evidence and continuously monitors connected systems (45, 49). It pulls proof directly from systems through its integrations and automated tests (16, 10, 18), including 40+ AWS resources (40), and its API extends automated collection to homegrown systems (32, 52, 2). Missing for 10: documented collection schedule or cadence, explicit timestamping or provenance details on the gathered artifacts, and independent or hands-on corroboration that this replaces screenshot and CSV evidence.
